items.text: Know what is meant by the terms empirical formula and molecular formula

items.text: Practical: Know how to determine the formula of a metal oxide by combustion (e.g. magnesium oxide) or by reduction (e.g. copper(Il) oxide)

items.label: list_item
items.text: Calculate reacting masses using experimental data and chemical equations

items.label: text
items.text: There are two types of chemical equation that you could be asked to write: word equations and symbol equations. Symbol equations are usually called chemical equations and you should only write a word equation if you are specifically asked to. All chemical equations must be balanced.
